claims: Maximum four-version gap; each stage completes before next; control plane before cluster.

claims: Manual Helm upgrade only; NGC is the sole artifact source; edition-specific control-plane flags are added when upgrading from v2.26 or earlier.
Cluster command uses bootstrapToken; validate Connected state and expected cluster version.
Back up cluster Helm/runtime config, control-plane Helm values, database, and metrics storage before upgrade.
Project/department resources[].priority removed; requests reject it, responses omit it; use rank.
JFrog removed; node-level scheduler and GPU memory swap cannot be re-enabled.
Cluster bootstrapToken replaces clientSecret; token expires after two hours.
Legacy native-workload controllers/CRDs are replaced; affected workloads need resubmission.
Legacy GitBook root still labels v2.26 latest, corroborating archive identity.
sources.limits: Do not use this stale latest label as global current-version evidence.
